name: 1Alexander AI Visibility Tracker
description: Tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention or cite your brand for the buyer questions you choose, and saves each answer with named brands and cited URLs. 17 MCP tools. Free plan: 1 brand, 6 prompts, weekly checks; Pro $49/month.
author: 1Alexander

tools.name: check_prompt
tools.title: Queue a tracked prompt re-run
tools.description: Queue a ChatGPT re-run of an active tracked prompt by exact brand name. Queues only when live checks are available and returns the request status. Workspace re-run and spend limits apply.

prompt.description: Exact text of the active tracked prompt.

brand.description: Exact name of the tracked brand.

engine.description: Engine to re-run the prompt on.

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.title: List tracked prompts
tools.description: Use list_brands to find brand_id. List tracked prompts in your connected workspace, optionally restricted to a brand. Includes inactive prompts that count toward plan capacity.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.title: List workspace brands
tools.description: List brands in your connected workspace with brand IDs, domains and tracked prompt counts, including inactive prompts.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: add_prompt
tools.title: Add a tracked prompt
tools.description: Use list_brands to find brand_id. Add a tracked prompt (commercial by default) to a brand in your workspace. Use type branded for a question that names the brand. Inactive prompts count toward workspace prompt capacity.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

text.description: Question to track in scheduled checks.

type.description: Prompt category. Use branded when the question names the brand.

tools.name: get_visibility
tools.title: View AI visibility trends
tools.description: Summarize unbranded visibility and brand knowledge from saved answers. Return weekly mention rates, ranking, changes where prompt coverage matches, and share of voice by engine and overall.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

engine.description: Filter to answers from this engine.

weeks.description: Number of weeks of visibility history to request.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.title: List cited sources
tools.description: Return cited URLs, domains, titles and occurrence counts from persisted successful answers in your organization, ordered by count.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

engine.description: Filter to answers from this engine.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: competitor_gap
tools.title: Find competitor gaps
tools.description: Find persisted answers where a recognized competitor is mentioned and your brand is absent. Optionally filter by competitor name.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

competitor.description: Competitor name or a recognized spelling variant.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Read plan, capacity, cadence and activity. No quota cost.

tools.name: create_brand
tools.title: Create brand
tools.description: Create a brand in the connected workspace, subject to workspace limits.

name.description: Display name of the tracked brand.

primary_domain.description: Primary domain of the tracked brand.

category.description: Product or service category of the brand.

tools.name: update_brand
tools.title: Update brand
tools.description: Update a workspace brand by ID, name or domain.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

name.description: Display name of the tracked brand.

primary_domain.description: Primary domain of the tracked brand.

category.description: Product or service category of the brand.

tools.name: update_prompts
tools.title: Update prompts
tools.description: Pause, resume or delete prompts. Delete requires confirm:true; otherwise returns the proposed deletions. Paused prompts consume capacity; deleted prompts free it.

prompt_ids.description: IDs of tracked prompts in this workspace.

action.description: Change to apply to the selected prompts.

confirm.description: Set to true after the user confirms the deletion preview.

tools.name: suggest_prompts
tools.title: Suggest prompts
tools.description: Generate template prompt suggestions without running model calls or using tracked prompt slots. Adapt them and confirm wording with the user before adding.

name.description: Name of the brand the prompts are for.

sells.description: Product or service category to ask about.

market.description: Geographic market to include in the prompts.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.title: List competitors
tools.description: List only competitors manually tracked in the workspace for the selected brand. Brands merely mentioned in answers or shown on the Overview leaderboard are excluded.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: add_competitor
tools.title: Add competitor
tools.description: Track a competitor for a brand in the connected workspace, subject to workspace limits.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

name.description: Display name of the competitor to track.

domain.description: Competitor hostname, without a scheme, port, or path.

tools.name: remove_competitor
tools.title: Remove competitor
tools.description: Remove a tracked competitor while retaining stored answer evidence.

competitor_id.description: ID of the tracked competitor to remove.

tools.name: get_prompt_answers
tools.title: Get prompt answers
tools.description: Read stored answers with named brands, deduplicated citations and answer text up to 4,000 characters by default. The truncated flag indicates clipped text. Set detail to full for complete text, stored citation rows and official citation annotations. Use list_engines to see which engines are available in the workspace. This tool never runs a model.

brand_id.description: Workspace brand ID, exact name, or domain.

prompt_id.description: Filter to this tracked prompt ID.

engine.description: Filter to answers from this engine.

since.description: Earliest answer timestamp, inclusive, in ISO 8601 UTC.

until.description: Latest answer timestamp, inclusive, in ISO 8601 UTC.

detail.description: Use full for complete answer text and stored citation details.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
